combatBattery.replenishment: Charges persist after discharge and do not refresh at ordinary turn start or combat start. A valid later replenishment opportunity restores them under strategic logistics rules.
combatBattery.tacticalRule: At most one charge may discharge in a tactical turn. There is no per-encounter cap, so one prolonged fight may consume all three charges over three or more turns.

powerCapacitor.tacticalRule: After discharge the capacitor is empty. On a later turn the ship may spend 1 otherwise available TP to recharge it; the recharged point becomes usable on a subsequent turn.
powerCapacitor.campaignRule: The capacitor is reusable rather than consumable; it shifts power between turns and never creates net Tactical Power.

shieldRecharge.rule: Any functional ship may allocate Tactical Power to shield recharge subject to the shield/recharge profile and available power. Combat Battery and Power Capacitor may alter available power but do not unlock recharge.

amm.rule: Hold 25 AMM rounds at both TL1 and TL2 for now. Finite interceptor ammunition is a multi-combat endurance constraint; normal play should not force routine return-to-port reloads after every missile engagement.

magazineExpansions.rule: Kinetic and Missile Magazine Expansions are endurance/logistics choices and require repeated-engagement stress evidence in addition to single-duel results.
